topic: What would happen if the speed of light was only 100 km/h?

scenario.title: What If Light Moved at 100 km/h?
scenario.clickbait_title: SPEED OF LIGHT just became 100 KM/H! (You're Already DEAD)
scenario.thumbnail_concept: A person's face reflected in a shattered mirror, but the reflection is clearly out of sync, distorted and showing a previous movement. Dark, dramatic lighting with a hint of red. Vertical composition, highly detailed.
scenario.seo_description: What if the speed of light slowed to just 100 km/h? Your reflection would lag, time would distort, and the Sun's light would take millennia to reach Earth. Explore the terrifying reality where physics breaks down. #shorts #science #whatif

scenes.narration: Your own reflection stares back from seconds ago. Every step you take, your body lags behind, a ghost of your past self. The world is a blurry, delayed nightmare. But why?
scenes.visual_prompt: A person stares into a shattered mirror, their reflection noticeably lagging, showing a movement from moments before. The scene is disorienting, distorted, with a faint, surreal glow, implying extreme delay. Cinematic lighting, vertical composition, 8K detail, photorealistic.
scenes.twist_element: The disorienting lag and the question 'But why?'

scenes.narration: Roli here. That lag? It's because light itself crawls at 100 kilometers per hour. Meaning every single thing you see, hear, or touch is from the past. Even worse, move too fast and time itself slows down for you, bending reality.
scenes.visual_prompt: Roli, the time-traveling rabbit scientist in steampunk goggles, points urgently at a flickering cityscape. Buildings and cars appear to stretch and warp, hinting at extreme relativistic effects. Dynamic perspective, cinematic lighting, vertical composition, 8K detail, photorealistic.
scenes.twist_element: Introduction of actual speed of light and relativistic time dilation.

scenes.narration: But Roli warns: The true horror isn't your reflection. The Sun's light now takes 1500 years to reach Earth. We'd be trapped in eternal night, watching a star that died millennia ago. Your own reflection stares back from seconds ago.
scenes.visual_prompt: A desolate, perpetually dark Earth landscape under a starless, black sky. A faint, ancient, ghostly image of the sun is barely visible, implying a light source from millennia past. Roli looks up in despair. Cinematic lighting, vertical composition, 8K detail, photorealistic.
scenes.twist_element: The sun's light taking 1500 years to reach Earth, leading to eternal night and a seamless loop back to the opening line.
